description:
*3 Bed, 3 Bath Home with garden and Vehicle wide side access *South/South-West orientation to rear!!  *BER B- Green Mortgage *Stroll to the village, Coffee Shops, Schools, Bars, Restaurants, Walkways and so much more. *Approx 7km to Killorglin, an easy commute to Killarney and Kerry’s Capital, Tralee. *Set in established development with ample green space. *Ideal Family/1st time Buyer or Right-Size Home *On-trend interiors. *Move in ready. Approx 114 sq.m. NOTE this is roughly 10-15% bigger than typical new builds!

Tommy Carmody’s Property House are excited to bring 4 Millbrook Village, Milltown, Co Kerry to the market.  

CALL OR TEXT TOMMY ON +35387706030 TO ARRANGE A TIME SLOT….

The home is situated in Millbrook Village, a well established development which is within walking distance of every required amenity in the Village of Milltown. Tralee, Kerry’s Capital and University Town is an easy commuting distance from the home and offers access to the likes of UHK, MTU, Manorwest Retail Park and the nearly completed Astellas Campus – essentially every amenity from Retail, Commercial, Medical, Educational, Leisure is a short drive away. If you are looking for home that comes with the benefit of a Village Community but with the convenience of close proximity to a city, this home is for you!

Accommodation 
Hallway: Naturally bright, with wood effect tiled floor, leads to the living room and kitchen/dining quarters and Guest WC…

Living Room: This is a fantastic room.  Situated to the front of the home it is naturally bright and has a feature fireplace with stove, stone surround and wooden mantle. With wooden floors. It looks out to the large green area in front.

Kitchen/Dining Quarters: Situated to the rear of the home over looking the rear garden it includes an array of floor and wall mounted units and has tiled floors and tiled splashback. Includes cooker, extractor fan, stainless steel sink and has allocated space for dishwasher, washing machine/dryer. There is 2 x access points to the garden – one via sliding doors from the dining portion and also off the kitchen section. There is plenty of space to accommodate even the largest dining table. The counterspace in place doubles as a breakfast bar. 

Guest WC: Beautifully presented with WC, WHB & tiled floor.

Upstairs
Landing: Leads to 3 x bedrooms, family bathroom and attic access. 

Bedroom 1 Ensuite: This room is an especially large room. Situated to the front of the home it can easily accommodate a Super - King Bed. With wood effect floor and ample space to add built in storage.  Overlooks green area.

En-suite: Complete with WC, WHB, Electric shower. It has tiled floors and is tiled around shower. 

Bedroom 2: Situated to the rear of the home overlooking the rear garden. It would be an double or twin room. With wood effect floors. 

Bedroom 3: Situated at the rear of the home over looking the garden, it currently acts as a double room and home office. With wood effect floors. 
Family Bathroom: Complete with Bath with shower fixture, WC, WHB, tiled floor and part tiled walls. 

Outside: There is off street parking to the front of the home with remainder in lawn, side access is wide enough to accommodate a trailer and car. The back garden includes a generous lawn with a portion set aside as a courtyard, ideal for sitting out in summer evenings given it has the best orientation you could ask for and given its positioning is very private.

Whilst every care has been taken in the preparation of these particulars, and they are believed to be correct, they are not warranted and intending purchasers / lessees should satisfy themselves as to the correctness of information given.
